raw_sections.skills: SKILLS Core Languages & Runtimes: NodeJS, NestJS, ExpressJS, REST API Development, Serverless framework, GraphQL, Python, WebSockets, JWT Authentication, Authentication & Authorization, API Integration, Puppeteer Frontend Architecture: ReactJS, NextJS, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Redux, Zustand, Angular, Context API, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, AG-Grid, Responsive Design, Cross-Browser Compatibility, Component Reusability, Frontend Optimization, Code Splitting, Lazy Loading Testing & Quality: Jest, React Testing Library, Enzyme, Unit Testing Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, Cognito, AppSync, RDS, SQS, SNS), CI/CD Pipelines, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Serverless Framework, Jira, Twilio, OpenVidu, Brightcove Databases & Data Layers: PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, Prisma ORM System Design & Methodologies: Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, Scalable Architecture, Microservices, Asynchronous processing, System Design, Message Queues, Micro-Frontend Architecture, Edge Caching, High Availability, Performance Tuning, Real-Time Applications, Agile/Scrum AI & Emerging Technologies: LLM Applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agent Workflows, Prompt Engineering, AI-assisted code generation & Optimization

EXPERIENCE The Transformation Group | Senior Software Developer. April 2025 – Present Project: Impact Studio (Five-Year Plan Module — Employer Premium Contribution Reporting) • Architected the frontend ecosystem using React for the Five-Year Plan module within Impact Studio, accelerating
automated plan forecasting and data-processing throughput by 12%.
Designed and engineered automated reporting tools utilizing the Domo data layer to analyze historical corporate data and generate financial projections on employer premium contribution limits.
Built and deployed a localized custom AI Agent automation workflow using Node.js and the OpenAI SDK; automated the extraction and compilation of complex multi-factor financial requirements from Excel sheets directly into deterministic, typed TypeScript calculation modules.
Orchestrated automated self-correction verification loops with Jest to cross-validate generated code outputs against legacy Excel math configurations, slashing manual engineering translation time by 30%.
Structured deterministic client-side state management layers with Zustand, improving predictability metrics by 22% while smoothly mapping factor-driven AI calculations into high-performance data-visualization graphs.
Spearheaded rendering optimization and asset bundle profiling across intensive data-visualization views, dropping structural code complexity by 18%.

Web Vitals and SEO performance by 25%.
Optimized legacy backend services and platform performance, reducing overall system latency by 30% and lowering cloud
infrastructure costs by 15%.
Built scalable asynchronous event-driven systems to improve global data availability and support distributed application
scalability across multiple regions.
Deutsche Bank | Senior Software Developer August 2023 – August 2024 Project: LDCUI Banking Dashboard & Client Onboarding Platform • Developed real-time banking dashboards using ReactJS, AG-Grid, and TypeScript to safely display financial transaction data
across varied clients.

Integrated high-performance frontend interfaces directly with enterprise backend layers structured on Java and the internal VAS framework.
• Migrated legacy banking modules into a decoupled frontend architecture, improving feature delivery speed by 25% and

Automated client verification components and customized lazy loading modules to improve overall application maintainability.
Particle41 LLP | Software Developer August 2019 – August 2023 Project: Forte Lessons (LMS) & OTT Infrastructure • Architected scalable OTT and live-streaming web applications using ReactJS, NextJS, GraphQL, brightcove and
WebSockets, sustaining 100K+ concurrent users during large-scale digital music festivals.
Engineered Forte Lessons virtual learning system using WebRTC, Serverless Framework, twillio and AppSync, driving a
20% increase in student retention. Project: Computer Share (Automate Boat) • Built an automation tool from scratch utilizing AWS Lambda, NestJS, Serverless Framework and OCR text parsing to
process tax returns automatically across multiple state portals, cutting manual workflow times by 40%.
Project: Classroom Door & Circle Media • Developed a multi-user virtual classroom frontend with an interactive Fabric.js whiteboard layer, Firebase Realtime DB,
and OpenVidu video calling integrations.
Managed automated CI/CD pipeline deployments using bitbucket and AWS infrastructure automation, maintaining 99.9% environment availability.
Terse Soft PVT LTD | Software Developer August 2018 – August 2019 Project: Aurovine, Credentia & Multi-Tenant Infrastructure • Designed distributed media streaming pipelines utilizing decentralized topologies, React.js frontend components, and
ExpressJS / PostgreSQL architectures, reducing transaction packet drop frequencies by 12%.
Developed immutable identity authentication layers leveraging IPFS protocol configurations with ExpressJS routers and PostgreSQL data stores, mitigating system interaction fraud metrics by 20%.
Engineered modular multi-tenant e-commerce architectures with scalable React.js layouts and secure ExpressJS API backends, producing a 15% expansion in net operational transaction capacity.
Built a custom B2B manufacturing CRM system using React.js, ExpressJS, and PostgreSQL to automate product consignment tracking and record complex inventory states in real time.
